    The base of a cyclic walk is joined (Fischbacher, Lemma 4.4, positive form) #

    In a cyclic zigzag walk whose peaks are distinct vertices and whose inner peaks are separating in the hull, every vertex lies below the base (cyc_max), and the two arrows at the base lie in one component of the morphisms into it inside the hull (cyc_join). This is the form of Lemma 4.4 used to restore separation after the cuts of Fischbacher's §5.4.
